title.fa: وقتی قانون و اخلاق یکدیگر را تکذیب کنند
title.en: When law and morality contradict each other
title.nl: When law and morality contradict each other

summary.fa: باستیا می‌گوید مردم میل قوی دارند هر چیز قانونی را مشروع بدانند؛ پس وقتی قانون چپاول را مجاز می‌کند، شهروند میان دو بدی گیر می‌افتد: پشت کردن به اخلاق یا زیر پا گذاشتن احترام به قانون. و چون قانون زور است، به کار بردنش در مذهب و اخلاق «تلاشی وحشیانه و بیهوده» است.
summary.en: Bastiat argues that people strongly incline to treat whatever is legal as legitimate; so when the law authorizes plunder, the citizen is caught between two evils: abandoning his moral sense or abandoning respect for the law. And since law is force, using it in matters of religion and morals is "a savage and futile effort."
summary.nl: Bastiat argues that people strongly incline to treat whatever is legal as legitimate; so when the law authorizes plunder, the citizen is caught between two evils: abandoning his moral sense or abandoning respect for the law. And since law is force, using it in matters of religion and morals is "a savage and futile effort."

text.fa: جملهٔ مرکزی: «زمانی که قانون و اخلاق همدیگر را تکذیب کنند، یک شهروند مجبور به انتخابی ظالمانه است: یا باید به اخلاق پشت کند و یا احترام به قانون را زیر پا گذارد. هر دو انحراف نتایج برابری دارند، و برای هر شخصی انتخاب بین این دو مشکل است.»
text.en: The central sentence: "when law and morality contradict each other, the citizen faces the cruel alternative of either losing his moral sense or losing respect for the law. Both deviations have equal consequences, and for anyone the choice between them is hard."
text.nl: The central sentence: "when law and morality contradict each other, the citizen faces the cruel alternative of either losing his moral sense or losing respect for the law. Both deviations have equal consequences, and for anyone the choice between them is hard."

text.fa: سرچشمهٔ مشکل یک عادت ذهنی است: «طبیعت قانون این است که از عدالت پشتیبانی کند. این مهم‌ترین دلیلی است که در افکار مردم قانون و عدالت یکی و چیز مشابهی می‌باشند؛ در تمامی ما یک طبع قوی وجود دارد که باور کنیم هر چیز قانونمندی مشروع می‌باشد.»
text.en: The source of the problem is a habit of mind: "it is the nature of law to support justice. This is the chief reason why in people’s minds law and justice are one and the same; in all of us there is a strong disposition to believe that whatever is legal is legitimate."
text.nl: The source of the problem is a habit of mind: "it is the nature of law to support justice. This is the chief reason why in people’s minds law and justice are one and the same; in all of us there is a strong disposition to believe that whatever is legal is legitimate."

text.fa: و نتیجهٔ خطرناکش: بسیاری «اشتباهاً فکر می‌کنند که امور عادلانه هستند زیرا قانون آن‌ها را چنین می‌سازد». پس برای این‌که چپاول در نظر بسیاری ظاهری عادلانه بگیرد، کافی است قانونی شود.
text.en: And its dangerous consequence: many "mistakenly think things are just because the law makes them so." So for plunder to look just to many people, it is enough that it be made legal.
text.nl: And its dangerous consequence: many "mistakenly think things are just because the law makes them so." So for plunder to look just to many people, it is enough that it be made legal.

text.fa: راه درست به‌دست آوردن احترام: «روش برای ایجاد احترام به قوانین این است که قوانین را قابل احترام سازیم» — یعنی مسئله در وجدان شهروند نیست، در محتوای قانون است.
text.en: The right way to earn respect: "the way to make laws respected is to make laws that deserve respect" — the problem lies not in the citizen’s conscience but in the law’s content.
text.nl: The right way to earn respect: "the way to make laws respected is to make laws that deserve respect" — the problem lies not in the citizen’s conscience but in the law’s content.

text.fa: و نتیجهٔ جمعیِ تحریف: «نتیجهٔ چپاول قانونی عمومی، هرج و مرج اخلاقی است، چراکه قانون و اخلاق به‌عنوان مجموعه‌ای منحصر به فرد در نظر گرفته می‌شوند.»
text.en: And the collective result of the perversion: "the consequence of universal legal plunder is moral chaos, because law and morality are taken to be a single body."
text.nl: And the collective result of the perversion: "the consequence of universal legal plunder is moral chaos, because law and morality are taken to be a single body."

text.fa: حد ابزار: «می‌گویید اینجا افرادی وجود دارند که از اخلاق و مذهب بهرهٔ کمی برده‌اند، و شما به قانون مراجعه می‌کنید. اما قانون زور است، و آیا لازم است اشاره کنم چه تلاش وحشیانه و بیهوده‌ای است که در مسائل مذهب و اخلاق اعمال زور شود؟»
text.en: The limit of the instrument: "you say there are people here who have little morality or religion, and you turn to the law. But law is force, and need I point out what a savage and futile effort it is to apply force in matters of religion and morals?"
text.nl: The limit of the instrument: "you say there are people here who have little morality or religion, and you turn to the law. But law is force, and need I point out what a savage and futile effort it is to apply force in matters of religion and morals?"

text.fa: و تفکیکی که در بحث آموزش می‌گذارد: کاری می‌تواند بدون اجبار انجام گیرد و همان کار می‌تواند با اجبار انجام شود — «با گرفتن پول از برخی برای پرداخت به معلم‌هایی که به وسیلهٔ دولت برای آموزش دیگران بدون هزینه در نظر گرفته شده‌اند». به گفتهٔ او «در مورد دوم قانون با تجاوز به آزادی و مالکیت مرتکب چپاول قانونی می‌گردد».
text.en: And a distinction he draws in the discussion of education: a thing can be done without compulsion, and the same thing can be done with it — "by taking money from some to pay teachers appointed by the state to teach others free of charge." On his view, "in the second case the law, by trespassing on liberty and property, commits legal plunder."
text.nl: And a distinction he draws in the discussion of education: a thing can be done without compulsion, and the same thing can be done with it — "by taking money from some to pay teachers appointed by the state to teach others free of charge." On his view, "in the second case the law, by trespassing on liberty and property, commits legal plunder."

text.fa: این بحث یک تنگنای واقعی را نام می‌گذارد، ولی خودش داوری نمی‌کند که وقتی قانون و اخلاق در تعارض‌اند کدام را باید مقدم داشت؛ تنها می‌گوید هر دو راه بد است و باید قانون را اصلاح کرد. تعارض‌های مشخص اخلاقی و قانونی در فلسفهٔ حقوق جداگانه بحث می‌شوند.
text.en: This argument names a real dilemma but does not itself adjudicate which should yield when law and morality conflict; it only says both roads are bad and the law should be reformed. Particular conflicts of legal and moral obligation are discussed separately in legal philosophy.
text.nl: This argument names a real dilemma but does not itself adjudicate which should yield when law and morality conflict; it only says both roads are bad and the law should be reformed. Particular conflicts of legal and moral obligation are discussed separately in legal philosophy.
